# Pre-status recipe histories

`history.db.gz` was generated by the unchanged compiler and workers at
`2baaf0c927cf8716c024b62c5f710e9d02c474ff` against the pinned JobDB SQLite
runtime. It contains two disposable jobs in `object-tests`, with no external
repository or credentials. The submitted YAML is retained verbatim so it still
contains the `status` keys the old parser ignored.

- `replay` ran to completion on the old worker. The new worker replays its
  recorded cell and workspace tasks without task workers, rendering status, or
  changing history, and produces the original business output.
- `interrupted` stopped after the old `parallel-launch` worker submitted the
  child, but before recording the task result. The new worker registers the
  new schema, retries the same launch, and waits for the original child.

To regenerate from the repository root, first clear live job routing variables
as in the verify hook. Then run:

```sh
repo=$PWD
scratch=$(mktemp -d)
git archive 2baaf0c927cf8716c024b62c5f710e9d02c474ff | tar -x -C "$scratch"
fixture=pkg/worker/compiler/testdata/pre-status-history
cp "$fixture/generate_test.go" "$scratch/pkg/worker/compiler/pre_status_generator_test.go"
(cd "$scratch" && C2J_GENERATE_PRE_STATUS_DB="$scratch/history.db" \
  go test -mod=readonly -count=1 -v ./pkg/worker/compiler -run '^TestGeneratePreStatusHistory$')
gzip -n -9 -c "$scratch/history.db" > "$repo/$fixture/history.db.gz"
```
